MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Patient Services Administrator

Permanent Part Time (30.4 hours per week)

Cabrini Malvern location

We're building for the better!

By 2036, more than 150,000 patients will look to us for healthcare every year.

At Cabrini Health we champion community, compassion and career fulfilment. Our teams are united by the shared purpose of making a meaningful contribution to exceptional, patient-centred care in well- resourced, world class facilities that inspire you to perform at your best and continuously grow professionally.

Join a Team That Keeps Healthcare Moving Behind the Scenes 

At Cabrini Health, our Patient Services team plays a vital role in delivering exceptional service - working behind the scenes to ensure every detail of a patient's health journey is captured, managed, and protected with precision. If you're passionate about detail, data integrity, and making a meaningful impact in healthcare - this is where your skills can truly shine. 

 

About the role

Cabrini Health is seeking several Administration Clerks to join our vibrant Patient Services team - primarily based at Malvern. You will provide vital administrative and customer service support across a variety of hospital departments, including Admissions, in a role that blends office-based tasks with patient-facing interactions.

Key responsibilities will include:

Processing patient registration information ensuring timely and accurate entry in WebPAS

Organising patients' financial files and other forms-labels with medical records in preparation for admission-surgery lists

Conduct pre-admission telephone calls to patients within 48 hours of hospital admission to clarify personal details and advise any out-of-pocket expenses

Compile information packs for patients, including relevant health fund and other information specific to each patient

Prepare information for patients upon discharge and collect any outstanding payments relating to their stay

Our department operates between the hours of 6:00AM - 9:00PM Monday - Sunday, so flexibility to cover a range of shifts is essential. Candidates need to be committed to be available to work a min of 4 days per week (weekdays preferred). The Emergency department requires availability with late night finishes up to 11pm. Short shifts offered to suit university commitments.

 

What we're looking for

Previous experience working with medical records or familiarity with medical terminology is a bonus, but not essential 

Certificate IV in Hospital Administration or Business Administration (desirable but not mandatory) 

A true team player - collaborative, dependable, and equally capable of working independently when required 

A passion for delivering exceptional customer service, with a friendly, patient-focused approach 

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a positive attitude that builds rapport across teams 

Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and adapt when needed 

A keen eye for detail and accuracy, ensuring every task is completed to a high standard 

Solid numeracy and literacy skills to support administrative efficiency 

Why join Cabrini?

Opportunity to increase your take-home pay with Salary Packaging up to $18,850 per year tax free

Attractive hourly rates, with guaranteed annual increases, plus 13% superannuation

Access to a range of staff benefits including retail offers, fitness passport, discounted hospital services and savings on eligible private health fund services

Opportunities for career growth and professional development

Hospital located close to public transport 

A welcoming mission-led workplace culture where you feel valued

Interested? To view the position description click here or for further information about the role please contact: Julie Oliver, Manager Operational Performance on 9508 1456

Does this sound like your new role? Bring your skills and enthusiasm to Cabrini Health and help optimise the patient experience and health outcomes for our community.

Cabrini Health acknowledges the importance of creating a work environment that is welcoming, safe, equitable and inclusive for people of all backgrounds and abilities. Inclusion is core to our mission.

As part of our commitment to Reconciliation and Closing the Gap in employment related outcomes, we encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples.

Working for Cabrini

Cabrini Health is a Catholic, private, for-purpose health service located in Melbourne's southeast. Inspired by the mission and ethic of care of the Cabrini Sisters, providing quality, compassionate care to our community for more than 75 years.

There is something special about Cabrini Health. Our highly skilled staff and specialists incorporate clinical research, innovative models of care and state-of-the-art technology to deliver the best possible care and outcomes for our patients. We demonstrate our mission to serve our community through outreach programs that support asylum seekers, provide healthcare in rural communities and in underdeveloped countries.

Our size, reputation and growth strategy ensure genuine opportunities for our people to learn, grow and realise potential.

Our values: Compassion - Integrity - Courage - Respect

MANDATORY FOR ALL NEW STAFF TO CABRINI

Employment with Cabrini Health will be based on satisfactory background checks such as professional references, National Police Check, vaccinations for annual Influenza plus a Working with Children Check (WWCC) may also be requested. Vaccination for COVID-19 is highly recommended.    Click here to Apply now →

Happy Travels is Australia’s leading backpacker travel agency, built on a passion for adventure and a commitment to creating unforgettable experiences. Despite the challenges faced by the travel industry in recent years, we’ve continued to grow by staying focused on what matters most - our people and our travellers.

We’re more than just a booking service. We’re a tight-knit, energetic team dedicated to helping backpackers and tourists make the most of their time in Australia, Fiji, and New Zealand. From once-in-a-lifetime tours to hidden local gems, we connect travellers with experiences that turn trips into lifelong memories.

At Happy Travels, it’s all about people, connection, and adventure.

Role Overview:

We are looking for an enthusiastic and dynamic Travel Sales Consultant to join our team. In this role, your primary focus will be face-to-face sales, actively engaging with potential clients on the streets and in hostels, especially targeting backpackers. You will use innovative networking strategies to build genuine relationships and guide travellers towards the best experiences our destinations have to offer.

Key Responsibilities:

- Proactively approach and engage with travellers on the streets and in hostels.
- Network with backpackers, using innovative strategies to build lasting relationships.
- Recommend the best tours, activities, and experiences based on travellers' interests.
- Continuously improve communication and sales skills through provided training and coaching.
- Collaborate in a diverse environment, connecting with people from various backgrounds.

Benefits:

- Competitive Annual Salary: $73,000 - $93,000 + super
- Attractive commissions and bonuses.
- Continuous sales training and leadership development.
- Free travel on tours and experiences.
- Exclusive discounts on transport and accommodation.

Qualifications:

- Valid working visa for Australia.
- Proven experience in face-to-face sales or a similar role.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to connect with strangers.
- Passion for travel and sharing experiences.
- Multilingual skills are a significant advantage.
- Previous sales and travel experience is a huge bonus.
- AQF Cert II or 1+ years of experience required.

Are You the Perfect Fit?
Do you thrive in face-to-face interactions? Can you approach strangers, connect with them, and offer tailored travel solutions? If you are innovative in building relationships and have a knack for sales, you might be the perfect addition to our team! Apply now and start your adventure with Happy Travels!

How to Apply:
Kickstart your journey with Happy Travels by sending through your CV and cover letter, highlighting your suitability and passions, to careers@happytravels.com.au.

Job Types: Full-time

Pay: $79,500 - $99,500 per year + super

Benefits:
- Employee discount
- Employee mentoring program
- Referral program

Schedule:
- Day shift

Supplementary Pay:
- Commission
- Performance bonus

Application Question(s):
- Which visa are you on and have you completed your 88 days?

Experience:
Sales: 1 year (Preferred)
Language: English (Required)
Work Authorisation: Australia (Required)

Trading under Publicis Communications Australia
Role: Technical Lead
Location: Sydney

Who we are

Consumer habits are anything but linear, and attention must be earned. At Digitas, we understand that, to break through, brands must be surprising, entertaining and authentic. 

Driven by imagination and fueled by deep cultural, consumer and business insights, we craft impactful creative experiences across every medium — from integrated campaigns, gaming, and physical experiences to full-length feature films. 

We earn the right for brands to be part of their customers’ networks. We drive growth with our amazing clients, through our capabilities in Consulting, Products & Platforms, Customer Engagement and Digital Media.

Part of Publicis Groupe, and a Leader in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Global Marketing Agencies, we’re proud to work with some of the world’s leading brands.

Digitas – The Networked Experience Agency


The role:

The purpose of this role is to lead the technical design and delivery of impactful customer engagement solutions using the Braze platform, focused on a single, high-profile client with room to grow across the agency. As the Technical Lead, you will translate creative ideas into actionable Braze and data solutions, ensuring seamless execution. You will collaborate with stakeholders, develop prototypes, mentor technical teams, and maintain high standards for performance, documentation, and innovation.

This role focuses on 2 core areas:
1.	Technical leadership and solution design 
2.	Stakeholder collaboration and team development

 
Day to day you’ll get:

•	Work cross-functionally with the client and our account, creative, strategy and analytics teams to translate creative ideas into technical and data requirements for the Braze platform. Your vision will ensure client success from idea to implementation. 
•	Scope/build rapid prototypes which help us to respond to client briefs and assess technical viability.
•	Be the main point of contact when it comes to data requirements for Braze. Liaise with internal and external teams to ensure that we are leveraging client data securely, effectively and efficiently.
Ensure that all solutions are endorsed and supported by our client’s global and local technology teams and that all established standards are adhered to.
•	Be the absolute subject matter expert for our internal team and clients when it comes to the Braze platform 
•	Advise and mentor a local/offshore technical delivery team, fostering growth, capability and process.  
•	Work with the Digitas tech team to troubleshoot, test, and optimize solutions to achieve maximum performance with minimal errors.
Ensure continuity for the account by establishing and maintaining standards across the tech team for documentation and knowledge exchange.

Skills:
•	Expert level on-tool skills with one of the major customer engagement platforms (Salesforce, Adobe, Braze) 
•	Candidates with Braze experience are preferred. 
•	Salesforce, Braze or other certifications are a plus but not required
•	Ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
•	Strong working knowledge of modern marketing data tools and integration patterns with an emphasis on how to solution data for targeting, personalisation and reporting 
•	Working knowledge of CDPs such as Segment, Tealium and mParticle. mParticle experience is a huge plus 
•	Analytical thinking, asking the right questions and challenging for better outcomes  
•	Strategic thinker, pushing the boundaries and always challenging us to think bigger or differently
•	Excellent collaboration, written and verbal communication skills

The person we are looking for has:

•	7+ years of experience working on the technical side of Martech, marketing automation or customer engagement roles
•	Background in prototyping and light coding. Minimally you should be strong in basic web languages (HTML, CSS, JS) and scripting languages such as Liquid or ActionScript. 
•	2+ years of experience articulating solution designs with Martech platforms
•	Proven track record of successful solution design work 
•	Experience working with complex data environments which depend on streaming data 
•	Experience managing and mentoring technical delivery teams
•	Bonus points for prior agency/consultancy experience, as well as working with/leading off-shore delivery teams

Got what it takes? We’d love to hear from you.

Our offer to you:

Be a part of the Publicis Groupe family, one of the world’s most progressive and dynamic modern communications businesses enjoying all the perks that come with our network offering:
•	Work with a diverse team where we value all the benefits of harnessing differences for our people, our clients and our business.
•	A committed Diversity Inclusion and Belonging strategy are driven through our Viva! Women, Tahi Katoa, Wholeself and Égalité programs
•	A creative, fun and rewarding office environment backed up by our Publicis Liberté flexibility approach
•	Access to employee benefits including – wellness programmes, learning and development opportunities, and network events
•	Day off on your birthday.

If you don’t tick every box in this ad, please don’t rule yourself out.  We focus on hiring people who share our values of inclusion, collaboration, adaptability, fearlessness, and integrity, rather than ticking boxes – so if this role resonates with you, please apply.

Diversity. Inclusion. Equity. More than just words, these are part of our DNA. 

At Publicis Groupe we are committed to the inclusion and recognition of all people; regardless of race, age, culture, ability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status and religious affiliation. We believe that to deliver the best solutions to our clients, our people need to reflect the diverse communities in which our clients operate in. We value diversity and the skills, knowledge and experience that difference brings to our culture and solutions. 

Uniqueness is powerful; without it we wouldn’t be where we are today. So be you – we like it that way. 

We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for people with disability or those that require additional support throughout the application process.  

Salary: Over threshold

result.description:
Happy Travels is Australia’s leading backpacker travel agency, built on a passion for adventure and a commitment to creating unforgettable experiences. Despite the challenges faced by the travel industry in recent years, we’ve continued to grow by staying focused on what matters most - our people and our travellers.

We’re more than just a booking service. We’re a tight-knit, energetic team dedicated to helping backpackers and tourists make the most of their time in Australia, Fiji, and New Zealand. From once-in-a-lifetime tours to hidden local gems, we connect travellers with experiences that turn trips into lifelong memories.

At Happy Travels, it’s all about people, connection, and adventure.

Role Overview:

We are looking for an enthusiastic and dynamic Travel Sales Consultant to join our team. In this role, your primary focus will be face-to-face sales, actively engaging with potential clients on the streets and in hostels, especially targeting backpackers. You will use innovative networking strategies to build genuine relationships and guide travellers towards the best experiences our destinations have to offer.

Key Responsibilities:

- Proactively approach and engage with travellers on the streets and in hostels.
- Network with backpackers, using innovative strategies to build lasting relationships.
- Recommend the best tours, activities, and experiences based on travellers' interests.
- Continuously improve communication and sales skills through provided training and coaching.
- Collaborate in a diverse environment, connecting with people from various backgrounds.

Benefits:

- Competitive Annual Salary: $79,500 - $99,500 + super
- Attractive commissions and bonuses.
- Continuous sales training and leadership development.
- Free travel on tours and experiences.
- Exclusive discounts on transport and accommodation.

Qualifications:

- Valid working visa for Australia.
- Proven experience in face-to-face sales or a similar role.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to connect with strangers.
- Passion for travel and sharing experiences.
- Multilingual skills are a significant advantage.
- Previous sales and travel experience is a huge bonus.
- AQF Cert II or 1+ years of experience required.

Are You the Perfect Fit?
Do you thrive in face-to-face interactions? Can you approach strangers, connect with them, and offer tailored travel solutions? If you are innovative in building relationships and have a knack for sales, you might be the perfect addition to our team! Apply now and start your adventure with Happy Travels!

How to Apply:
Kickstart your journey with Happy Travels by sending through your CV and cover letter, highlighting your suitability and passions, to careers@happytravels.com.au.

Job Types: Full-time

Pay: $73,000 - $93,000 per year + super

Benefits:
- Employee discount
- Employee mentoring program
- Referral program

Schedule:
- Day shift

Supplementary Pay:
- Commission
- Performance bonus

Application Question(s):
- Which visa are you on and have you completed your 88 days?

Experience:
Sales: 1 year (Preferred)
Language: English (Required)
Work Authorisation: Australia (Required)
Work Location: In person

result.description:
Job description

Australia Network Services Pty Ltd (ANS) is seeking a suitably qualified and experienced Software Engineer for our client operating in the software development, IT services, and digital solutions industry in Sydney, Australia.

On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, maintaining, and improving software applications and systems. You will work closely with internal teams, business stakeholders, and technical staff to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused software solutions.


Job Title: Software Engineer, Full-Time Position
ANZSCO Code: 261313 Software Engineer
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 38 hours per week
Work Location: In person
Industry: Software Development / IT Services / Digital Solutions


Key Responsibilities
The successful candidate will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system design, frontend and backend development, database integration, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing system maintenance.

Main Duties and Tasks
- Analyse business and technical requirements and translate them into software solutions.
- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications, platforms, and system features.
- Develop frontend interfaces using technologies such as JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and application logic using suitable programming languages and frameworks.
- Design, manage, and optimise databases using SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar database systems.
- Develop RESTful APIs and support integration between internal systems and third-party platforms.
- Write clean, efficient, reusable, and maintainable code in accordance with development standards.
- Conduct debugging, troubleshooting, code reviews, and performance optimisation.
- Participate in system design, software architecture planning, and technical documentation.
- Support cloud-based deployment, version control, CI/CD, and DevOps activities using tools such as AWS, Azure, Git, Jenkins, or similar.
- Work with product managers, designers, business users, and technical teams to deliver software that meets business objectives.
- Prepare user guides, technical documentation, release notes, and system support materials.
- Maintain data security, system reliability, and compliance with workplace policies and procedures.
- Support ongoing system upgrades, enhancements, and legacy system improvements.

Essential Requirements
- Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience as a Software Engineer, Software Developer, Full-Stack Developer, or in a similar software development role.
- Experience in frontend development using JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, or similar technologies.
- Experience with backend development, APIs, databases, and system integration.
- Knowledge of programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java, or similar.
- Experience with SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or other relational database systems.
- Understanding of software development lifecycle, system design, testing, debugging, and deployment processes.
- Experience using Git, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools, or DevOps practices is highly regarded.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical troubleshooting skills.
- Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced technical environment.


If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position and assess your suitability for the role.
result.title: Software Engineer
